description: This file defines the 'FeaturesCreated' event class, which models an event emitted after a 'Features' object has been created for a specific 'Thing' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing instances, serializing/deserializing JSON, and accessing event properties.

classes.name: FeaturesCreated
classes.description: An immutable event class indicating that Features for a Thing were created, containing methods for serialization, deserialization, and property access.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new FeaturesCreated instance with specified parameters, including deprecated overloads.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of FeaturesCreated from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the Features object associated with this event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the Features object to JSON according to schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the features resource.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends the features payload to a JSON object builder, respecting schema and predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode for the FeaturesCreated object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare FeaturesCreated objects.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equals, confirms if other object is instance of FeaturesCreated.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString for meaningful string representation.
